counters.text: The PG was ₹8,000 with food, Aunty. ₹8,000 here?
I'm salaried, Aunty — one month deposit is enough, no?
One month deposit. I'll pay the rent on the 1st, every month.

lines.concede: Hmm. {amount}. Because Manju sent you — and because you look like you eat properly.
lines.hold: That is the rate, kanna. Water is free, signal is free. {total}.
lines.offended: No deposit? Then no room. This is not a dharamshala.
lines.final: {total}. Final. The tank fills at six, don't waste.
lines.callback: Wait — okay, {amount}. Go and come back with the money.
